verdict.rationale: TypeSafe publishes some quantified claims in its cookbooks, such as reranking top-1 accuracy rising from 5% to 18% and batching being 12.2x cheaper. It describes the method only briefly (one question per query-candidate pair) and ships an adapter meant for comparing TypeSafe against LLMs on cost, speed and intelligence, which gives some auditability. Community skepticism about the lack of launch evidence is general and does not concretely contradict the cookbook figures. Missing for 10: named eval datasets, full settings and prompts per benchmark, a documented reproducible harness for headline model claims, and independent reproduction.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, published benchmark claims come with enough methodology — eval names, settings, harness or prompts — that I could reproduce or at least audit them

citations.quote: uses one TypeSafe question per query-candidate pair to raise top-1 accuracy from 5% to 18% and top-10 accuracy from 38% to 62%.
batching every question into one TypeSafe call is 12.2x cheaper and 10.0x faster with no change in answers

Useful for comparing TypeSafe against an LLM on
cost/speed/intelligence.
